action: Follow up with ChargePoint to confirm the site assessment is scheduled and push for the earliest available installation date. The loan is disbursed, the decision is made, and every week between now and installation is dead weight on the debt service. I need a concrete installation window - not a tentative one. Push for a date within the next 30 days. Confirm the revenue-share structure terms directly with ChargePoint's account rep: what percentage goes to them, what goes to me, what is the minimum monthly guarantee if any, and whether fleet accounts get a different rate than retail. I need these numbers firsthand so I can model the actual offset against my loan payment.
